LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: SF PEG DC Rich Text Display
LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a rich text field of the current record (e.g. an External Object) via lightning-formatted-rich-text. Part of the PEG_DC_EXT package.

property.name: fieldName
property.label: Field Name
property.description: API name of the rich text field to display (e.g. Description__c).

property.name: wrappingClass
property.label: Wrapping CSS Class
property.description: CSS Classes for the wrapping div

property.name: fieldLabel
property.label: Field Label
property.description: Optional label override (field label from object metadata used by default).

property.name: isDebug
property.label: Debug?
property.description: Activates debug logs in the browser console.
